xt> Free-text note stored on the run\n --min-pass-rate <n> Pass threshold for th

Maximum time to wait for completion (default 600000; a run held for its judge gets up to 31 more minutes un
less this flag is set)\n --reporter <json-summary|junit-xml|html> Render the completed run report to stdout\n --out <path>

omputer <id-or-name> Sandbox image to pin on the composed stack\n --compose-model <id...> Model(s) to

ite (append, capped at 10). Default is ephemeral.\n --compose-server <id-or-name...> Server(s) to pin on the composed st
ack. Snapshots them into a server group, so the run keeps testing these servers even if the host's own server list changes later.
